name: Content moderation
summary: Classify a post against a stated policy and ask whether it violates it.

input.state: The policy summary followed by the post's text.

violation.instructions: The post violates the policy the state opens with.
violation.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

criteria.none: No violation - the category question is moot.

uncertainty.abstain: borderline posts answer violation:false at low probability - the caller flags probability < 0.7 for human review
uncertainty.refusal: a refused post reports refused; moderation defaults to human review, never auto-clean

limits: A policy judgment, not a legal one - the caller's policy text is the whole standard.
No image or video input - text posts only.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
